purpose: Seed file for human-reviewed local mnemonic site aliases. These are not the same as official VA station codes unless independently verified.
governance_note: Treat aliases as display/search helpers until reviewed and approved. Keep source_reference and confidence explicit.
matching_note: Use exact public facility_id when known. Public VA display names may not contain the local mnemonic wording, so do not require name_contains for seeded high-confidence local mappings unless needed to disambiguate.
